Tiamonds LP Rewards Program is Live: Earn from Your Liquidity

July 22, 2025 - 4 min read

The Tiamonds LP Rewards Program is officially live, offering liquidity providers a unique opportunity to earn from their contributions. Over a four-week campaign, a total of 2.5 million $TOTO tokens will be distributed to participants who provide liquidity to the $ETH/TOTO pool on Uniswap V4. This initiative aims to deepen on-chain liquidity, improve trading conditions for $TOTO, and reward community members who actively support the ecosystem. With no lock-ins and flexible participation, it’s designed to encourage long-term involvement while keeping things simple.

Key Highlights

  • 2.5 million $TOTO tokens will be distributed over 4 weeks.
  • Provide liquidity to the $ETH/TOTO pool on Uniswap V4 to start earning.
  • Weekly multipliers increase your rewards, reaching up to 1.5x in Week 4.
  • No lock-in period. Liquidity must stay active for at least 24 hours to qualify.
  • Rewards are based on your liquidity’s USD value contribution and time in the pool, with a real-time leaderboard to track performance.

What Is the LP Rewards Program?

The Tiamonds LP Rewards Program is a four-week campaign designed to reward liquidity providers who contribute to the $ETH/TOTO pool on Uniswap V4. Participants earn points based on both the amount of liquidity they provide and how long it remains in the pool. At the end of the campaign, 2.5 million $TOTO tokens will be distributed proportionally to all participants based on their points.

How It Works

To participate, simply add liquidity to the $ETH/TOTO pool on Uniswap V4. Once your funds are added, you start earning points automatically. Points accumulate based on your liquidity’s USD value and the duration it stays active. The system rewards consistency and encourages participants to maintain liquidity for the entire campaign.

Rewards Calculation

Your points are calculated using the following formula:

Points = (Your Liquidity valued in USD / 100) × Duration Multiplier

The multiplier increases each week to reward long-term participants:

  • Week 1: 1.1x
  • Week 2: 1.2x
  • Week 3: 1.3x
  • Week 4: 1.5x

Example:
 If you provide $1,000 in liquidity and keep it in the pool for all 4 weeks, your total points will be:
(1000 / 100) × 1.5 = 15 points.

No Lock-In, Full Flexibility

Unlike traditional programs, there are no lock-ins. You’re free to withdraw your liquidity at any time. However, to qualify for rewards, your liquidity must remain active for at least 24 hours. Staying longer in the pool, especially for the full 4 weeks, will maximize your returns due to the growing weekly multipliers.

Track Your Progress Through Leaderboard

To add a competitive and transparent edge, a live leaderboard is available. This dashboard displays your rank, total points, and your comparison to other participants. It’s a real-time tool to help you optimize your strategy and ensure you’re on track for the best rewards.

(Link to leaderboard dashboard)

Rewards Distribution

At the campaign’s conclusion, the 2.5 million $TOTO tokens will be distributed based on the weighted average of points earned by all participants. Rewards are proportional to your contribution and activity duration, meaning early and consistent liquidity providers will gain the most benefit.

Why This Matters

Liquidity is vital for efficient trading and price discovery. By participating in this program, you’re not just earning rewards, you’re strengthening the Tiamonds ecosystem by ensuring deeper liquidity and better trading conditions for all $TOTO holders.

Final Thoughts

The Tiamonds LP Rewards Program is your chance to put your assets to work while actively supporting the growth of the ecosystem. Add liquidity to the $ETH/TOTO pool, stay active, track your progress, and watch your rewards grow.Ready to Join?
